tools.name: depin_list_providers
tools.description: List DePIN provider listings. Filter by category (storage, compute, gpu, bandwidth, energy, sensor, wireless), region, or capacity. No auth required.

tools.name: depin_create_listing
tools.description: List physical infrastructure capacity (storage TB, compute cores, GPU VRAM, bandwidth Mbps, sensor sample rate, etc.). 22 metadata fields supported. Match fee 0.15%.

tools.name: depin_get_match_fee
tools.description: Get the current DePIN marketplace match fee (currently 0.15%). Returned alongside settlement currencies and chains.
